metadata.description: EGPT — a new approach to AI built on FRQTL, a fractal compression model. Meet Maxi, a robotic AI that imagines the physical world: build simulations for it to learn from while it is awake, and watch it dream variations of them at night. Contributions earn reputation tracked on-chain.

plugins.name: godsworld
plugins.description: Gods World — talk to Maxi, build physically realistic simulations for it to learn from, and see what it dreams about.

plugins.name: frqtl
plugins.description: FRQTL Lab — adopt the FRQTL builder or experiment-designer role and run visual physics experiments with the published @descix/frqtl-sdk. Personas, method, and recipes are served live by the egpt-frqtl app over the DeSciX MCP connector; this plugin is the thin adopter.
